inert_filler.mechanism: TiO2 is a chemically inert filler (dilution and pore filling)
inert_filler.relation: no new phase; XRD = superposition; anatase intensity proportional to its fraction

ti_incorporation.mechanism: TiO2 incorporates into the aluminosilicate network (Ti substitution, titanosilicate)
ti_incorporation.relation: consumption of anatase and new or shifted reflections

filler_reinforcement.mechanism: TiO2 densifies the matrix and raises strength
filler_reinforcement.relation: filler densification: fewer pores, higher strength (Ryshkewitch: sigma = sigma0 exp(-b P))

binder_dilution.mechanism: TiO2 replaces reactive metakaolin, leaving less binder gel and a weaker paste
binder_dilution.source: Duxson et al., J. Mater. Sci. 42 (2007) 2917

third_body_lubrication.mechanism: a TiO2/gel third-body tribolayer lowers friction and wear
third_body_lubrication.relation: tribolayer reduces adhesion: lower mu and wear

abrasive_third_body.mechanism: hard anatase particles act as abrasive third bodies (ploughing)
abrasive_third_body.relation: Archard/abrasive wear: harder debris raises wear and friction
abrasive_third_body.source: Archard 1953; Rabinowicz, Friction and Wear of Materials
